notes: Single assertion combines sub-checks (1)-(4); no disable iff because (2) covers reset. Outstanding requests tracked per a_source (256 entries) from accepted request to accepted response. A source reused in the same cycle its response completes is tolerated. CTRL.active_0 model updates on error-free response to a write to 0x004 with mask[0]=1. Address matching is word-granular (address[31:2]).
